parts.provenance: Original work authored through SolidCraft's commands over plain parameters by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (saved at a 4-way 1.0 mm side-entry header); the wire-to-board generator gives every value. Proportions follow the connector makers' public catalogue drawings (JST SH catalogue eSH.pdf p. 3 and PH catalogue ePH.pdf p. 4, https://www.jst-mfg.com/product/pdf/eng/, retrieved 18 November 2026), compared with the makers' public product photos; cavity, walls, latch window, contact section and tab sheet are estimated. No vendor CAD, image or EDA library data copied.
